title: Checkpoints
blurb: A small history replay in four ranges. In each range two subagents fork lanes of their own from main and write a folder of two files with layerfs fs; the lead merges the lanes, publishes the range to main and checks that main lists every file written so far.
prompt: Build up main in four ranges. In each range have two subagents fork lanes of their own and write a folder of two files each, then merge the lanes, publish the range and check that main lists every file written so far.

root.say: Four ranges, two agents each. Each range ends at a checkpoint.

subagent.prompt: You are a01 of the checkpoints demo. Each turn writes your part of the range the lead names on a lane of your own; report when it is done.
You are a02 of the checkpoints demo. Each turn writes your part of the range the lead names on a lane of your own; report when it is done.

root.reply: Waiting for a01 and a02 to finish range 1.

root.say: Both lanes of range 1 are done: merging and publishing.

bash.description: Range 1: merge the lanes and publish
bash.command:
layerfs branch merge r1-a01 r1-a02 r1 -m "range 1"
layerfs branch publish r1

root.say: Checking main at the end of range 1.
root.note: main lists the 4 files ranges 1 to 1 wrote.

root.reply: Waiting for a01 and a02 to finish range 2.

root.say: Both lanes of range 2 are done: merging and publishing.

bash.description: Range 2: merge the lanes and publish
bash.command:

layerfs branch publish r2

root.say: Checking main at the end of range 2.
root.note: main lists the 8 files ranges 1 to 2 wrote.

root.reply: Waiting for a01 and a02 to finish range 3.

root.say: Both lanes of range 3 are done: merging and publishing.

bash.command:

root.say: Checking main at the end of range 3.
root.note: main lists the 12 files ranges 1 to 3 wrote.

root.reply: Waiting for a01 and a02 to finish range 4.

root.say: Both lanes of range 4 are done: merging and publishing.

bash.description: Range 4: merge the lanes and publish
bash.command:
layerfs branch merge r4-a01 r4-a02 r4 -m "range 4"
layerfs branch publish r4

root.say: Checking main at the end of range 4.
root.note: main lists the 16 files ranges 1 to 4 wrote.

root.reply: All four ranges reached their checkpoints; every gate passed.
